header.title: Dropdown Menu
header.description: Menu that opens from a button and lists actions on something specific: edit, duplicate or delete a document, or the options of an account. It also supports checkboxes, exclusive options and submenus. The panel renders in a portal above the page, so no container clips it.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props and see the result and the code instantly. Open the menu with a click or with the arrow keys from the button.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: Pass the button in `trigger` and the options in `items`. It opens on click and closes on select, with Escape or when clicking outside. `onAction` receives the chosen `id`. Each item can have an `icon`, a `shortcut` (visual only, it doesn't register the key) and an `href` to work as a link. Use `type: "separator"` to group.

iconTrigger.title: Icon button
iconTrigger.description: The trigger can be any element that accepts `onClick`, for example a `Button` with `iconOnly`. Since it has no text, pass `aria-label`. It's the typical three-dots pattern on a row or card; with `placement="bottom-end"` the menu aligns to the right.

disabledDanger.title: Disabled and destructive
disabledDanger.description: `disabled` keeps the item visible but dimmed, and the keyboard skips it. `description` adds a help line, useful to explain why it's unavailable. `danger` paints the item red for destructive actions; keep it separated from the rest.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` changes the padding and text of the items: `sm`, `md` (default) or `lg`. You set the trigger size yourself; keep them matched.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: `placement` sets which side of the trigger it opens on and how it aligns. If the menu doesn't fit on that side of the window, it opens on the other one (top or bottom) and never gets cut off, so near the edge of the screen it may not follow the requested side. `offset` is the distance in pixels from the trigger.

selection.title: Checkboxes and options
selection.description: `type: "checkbox"` adds an option that toggles on and off, and `type: "radio-group"` a group of exclusive options. Unlike actions, the menu stays open after changing them. `type: "label"` adds a section title.

submenu.title: Submenu
submenu.description: `type: "submenu"` groups options in a second level. It opens on hover or with the right arrow, and closes with the left arrow or Escape. If there's no room on the sides, like on a phone, it shows inside the same panel.

apiLink: See the full Dropdown Menu API

header.title: Dropdown Menu API
header.description: API reference for the DropdownMenu React component: props, item types, CSS classes, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or from its subpath.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the HTML attributes of a <div> (HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>) and passes them to the menu panel, not the container. The same goes for className. For the trigger container use classNames.root. classNames accepts root, trigger, menu, item, label, separator and shortcut.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.trigger: The trigger gets aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing to the panel.
a11y.menu: The panel has role="menu" with menuLabel as its aria-label, and marks the active item with aria-activedescendant.
a11y.items: Actions have role="menuitem", checkboxes menuitemcheckbox and options menuitemradio, with aria-checked. Option groups have role="group".
a11y.keyboard: From the trigger, the down and up arrows open the menu on the first or last item. Inside, the arrows move through items, Home and End go to the ends, Enter or Space select and Escape closes.
a11y.typeahead: Typing a letter jumps to the first item whose text starts with it.
a11y.submenu: Submenus have aria-haspopup and aria-expanded. The right arrow opens them and the left one goes back.
a11y.focus: When closing with Escape or selecting, focus returns to the trigger. Tab closes the menu.
a11y.disabled: Disabled items have aria-disabled and the keyboard skips them.
a11y.labels: menuLabel defaults to English ("Actions"). Pass it translated. If a label is not text, use ariaLabel.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles. The panel renders in `document.body`, outside the container, so selectors that depend on it won't reach it.

rules.ready: Applied once the panel is positioned. Until then it stays invisible.
rules.size: Applied to the panel based on `size`.
rules.active: Active item, hovered or chosen with the keyboard.
rules.labelText: Item text. Truncated with an ellipsis.
rules.submenuLayout: `start` opens the submenu to the left and `nested` shows it inside the panel when there's no room on the sides.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Dropdown Menu has no variables of its own: it uses gem-system tokens directly. To change colors on a single menu, redefine those tokens in a class on the panel.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: gem-system tokens used by Dropdown Menu.

items.--gem-color-bg: Background of the panel and submenus.
items.--gem-color-fg-muted: Descriptions, shortcuts, section titles and arrows.
items.--gem-color-error-500: Background of the active destructive item.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts the HTML attributes of the panel.

items.items: Menu entries: actions, separators, titles, checkboxes, options and submenus.
items.trigger: Element that opens the menu, usually a `Button`. Receives the ARIA attributes and the `onClick`.
items.placement: Side and alignment of the panel: `bottom-start`, `bottom`, `bottom-end`, `top-start`, `top` or `top-end`.
items.offset: Distance in pixels between the trigger and the panel.
items.matchTriggerWidth: Makes the panel at least as wide as the trigger.
items.isDisabled: Disables the trigger and prevents opening.
items.open: Whether the menu is open. Controlled mode.
items.defaultOpen: Whether it starts open. Uncontrolled mode.
items.onOpenChange: Called when opening or closing. Receives the new state.
items.onAction: Called when an action is chosen. Receives its `id`.
items.onCheckedChange: Called when a checkbox changes. Receives the `id` and the new value.
items.onRadioChange: Called when an option is chosen. Receives the group `id` and the option `id`.

action.title: DropdownMenuActionItem
action.description: Regular action. It's the default type, so `type` is optional.

items.label: Item text.
items.shortcut: Shortcut shown on the right. Visual only.
items.href: Turns the item into an `<a>` link.
items.rel: Relationship with the destination. With `_blank` it defaults to `noopener noreferrer`.
items.disabled: Shows it dimmed and it can't be chosen.
items.danger: Paints it red for destructive actions.
items.ariaLabel: Accessible name when `label` is not text.

checkbox.title: DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
checkbox.description: Option that toggles on and off.

items.id: Unique identifier. Passed to the menu's `onCheckedChange`.
items.label: Item text.
items.disabled: Shows it dimmed and it can't be changed.
items.closeOnSelect: Closes the menu when changed. By default it stays open.
items.ariaLabel: Accessible name when `label` is not text.
items.onCheckedChange: Called when changed. Receives the new value.

radio.title: DropdownMenuRadioGroupItem
radio.description: Group of exclusive options. Each option (`DropdownMenuRadioOption`) has `id`, `label`, `description` and `disabled`.

items.id: Group identifier. Passed to the menu's `onRadioChange`.
items.label: Group title. It's also its accessible name.
items.onValueChange: Called when an option is chosen. Receives its `id`.

submenu.title: DropdownMenuSubmenuItem
submenu.description: Item that opens a second level.

items.label: Item text.
items.items: Submenu entries. Supports actions and checkboxes.
items.disabled: Shows it dimmed and it can't be opened.
items.ariaLabel: Accessible name when `label` is not text.

other.title: Separators and titles
other.description: Items without an action to organize the menu.

items.label: Section title. It can't be chosen.
